title: 职场日常词汇
goal: 办公室、会议、日程；时态综合复习

steps.title: 新同事的第一天
lines: A
Welcome to the team, Ryan. This is your cubicle, next to the window.
欢迎加入，瑞安。这是你的隔间，在窗户旁边。
B
Thanks. Where can I find a stapler and some binders?
谢谢。订书机和文件夹在哪儿拿？
A
All the stationery is in the supply closet at the end of the hall.
文具都在走廊尽头的储物间。
B
Great. And is there a copier on this floor?
好的。这层有复印机吗？
A
Yes, it's next to the filing cabinets. The receptionist can give you a code.
有，在文件柜旁边。前台会给你密码。
steps.note: TOEIC 的场景几乎都在办公室。先把“办公室里有什么”说熟。

steps.title: 描述办公室：There is / are + 地点介词
what: 说“某处有某物”：There is + 单数 / 不可数，There are + 复数。
地点介词：next to（旁边）、across from（对面）、at the end of（尽头）、on the wall（墙上）、in the corner（角落）。
why: TOEIC Part 1（看图）和 Part 3（对话）里，问“东西在哪儿”是最常见的题。答案往往就是一个介词短语。
There be 后面跟着的名词决定 is / are（就近原则）：There is a copier and two printers.（离 is 最近的是 a copier）
zh: 中文“墙上有一块白板”→ 英语把地点放后面：There is a whiteboard on the wall.，不说 On the wall has a whiteboard。
ex: There is a projector in the meeting room.
会议室里有一台投影仪。
There are two filing cabinets next to the copier.
复印机旁边有两个文件柜。
The bulletin board is across from the elevator.
公告栏在电梯对面。
err: There is a whiteboard on the wall.
There are a copier in the hall.
There is a copier in the hall.
steps.sum: There is / are + 物 + 地点介词短语；地点放句末。

drill.q: There ___ some binders in the supply closet.
“复印机在文件柜旁边。”
o: The copier is next to the filing cabinets.
The copier is next the filing cabinets.
Next to the filing cabinets has the copier.

drill.zh: 会议室里有一台投影仪。
a: There is a projector in the meeting room.
There's a projector in the meeting room.
There is a projector in the conference room.

steps.title: 可数还是不可数：stationery、equipment、furniture
what: stationery（文具）、equipment（设备）、furniture（家具）、information、advice 都是不可数：不加 -s，不用 a。
要数个数时说单个东西：a stapler、two binders，或者 a piece of equipment / furniture。
why: 这些词是“一类东西的总称”，就像中文“文具”不说“三个文具”。TOEIC Part 5 常考：many equipment ✗ → much equipment / a lot of equipment ✓。
zh: 中文“很多设备”“一些家具”数不数都行，英语要分清：many 只跟可数复数，much 跟不可数。
ex: We need some new office equipment.
我们需要一些新的办公设备。
All the stationery is in the supply closet.
所有文具都在储物间。
We bought three pieces of furniture.
我们买了三件家具。
err: We ordered a lot of new equipment.
The stationeries are in the closet.
The stationery is in the closet.
steps.sum: stationery / equipment / furniture 不加 s，用 much / a lot of / a piece of。

drill.q: The company bought a lot of new ___.
How ___ furniture do we need for the lounge?

a: All the stationery is in the supply closet.
All of the stationery is in the supply closet.

steps.text: All the stationery is in the supply closet at the end of the hall.
steps.zh: 文具都在走廊尽头的储物间。
steps.focus: stationery 重音在第一个音节；at the end of 连读

steps.q: You can find a stapler in the ___ at the end of the hall.
Please put the notice on the ___.
The ___ will give you a visitor's pass at the front desk.
Each new employee gets a computer ___ with two monitors.
a: workstation

steps.a: There is a whiteboard on the wall.
The copier is next to the filing cabinets.

a: Is there a copier on this floor?
Is there a photocopier on this floor?

points: 重点：There is / are + 物 + 地点介词（next to、across from、at the end of、on the wall）。

steps.title: 改会议时间
lines: A
I'm afraid I can't make it to the meeting on Thursday.
恐怕我周四的会去不了了。
B
No problem. Let's reschedule it. What's your availability next week?
没关系，我们改个时间。你下周什么时候有空？
A
I'm free on Tuesday afternoon. Could we postpone it until then?
周二下午有空。能推迟到那时吗？
B
Sure. I'll update the agenda and send it to all attendees.
可以。我会更新议程，发给所有参会者。
A
Thanks. And could someone take the minutes? I'd like to read them later.
谢谢。能找人做会议记录吗？我想之后看看。
steps.note: 会议改期是 TOEIC Part 3 和 Part 7 最高频的话题之一。

steps.title: 改期的四个动词：postpone、reschedule、cancel、move up
what: postpone / put off：推迟（往后挪）
reschedule：重新安排时间（前后都可能）
cancel：取消；move up / bring forward：提前
why: TOEIC 的题常把 postpone 换成 delay / put off / push back 来考同义替换：听到 postponed，选项里常写 delayed。
postpone + 名词 / doing：postpone the meeting、postpone making a decision（后面不接 to do）。
zh: 中文“推迟到周二”→ postpone it until Tuesday / to Tuesday 都可以；“提前到周一”→ move it up to Monday。
ex: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
会议推迟到下周了。
Can we move the deadline up to Friday?
能把截止日期提前到周五吗？
We need to reschedule the client visit.
我们得重新安排客户来访的时间。
err: The meeting was postponed to earlier.
steps.sum: postpone / put off 推迟，move up 提前，reschedule 改时间，cancel 取消。

drill.q: The launch was ___ because the product wasn't ready.
We decided to postpone ___ the new system.

a: The meeting has been postponed until next week.
The meeting was postponed until next week.
The meeting has been postponed to next week.

steps.title: 说日程安排：现在进行时和 will
what: 已经定好的安排（有时间、有人约好）用现在进行时：I'm meeting the client at three.
临时决定、答应、预测用 will：I'll send you the agenda.
时刻表、固定日程用一般现在时：The workshop starts at 9 a.m.
why: Part 3 的问题“What will the man do next?”答案常藏在 I'll …（临时决定）里；问“When is the meeting?”答案常在 We're meeting … / It starts at … 里。
zh: 中文“我下午见客户”没有时态标记，英语要看是不是已经安排好：已安排 → I'm meeting；刚决定 → I'll meet。
ex: I'm having lunch with a supplier tomorrow.
我明天和一个供应商吃午饭。
OK, I'll update the schedule now.
好，我现在就更新日程。
The conference starts at nine sharp.
会议九点整开始。
err: I meet the client tomorrow at three.
I'm meeting the client tomorrow at three.
The phone is ringing. I answer it.
The phone is ringing. I'll answer it.
steps.sum: 约好的 → be doing；当场决定 → will；时刻表 → 一般现在时。

drill.q: A: We're out of paper. B: I ___ some from the supply closet.
Ms. Park ___ the new interns next Monday. It's on her calendar.

a: I'm meeting the client tomorrow afternoon.
I am meeting the client tomorrow afternoon.
I'm meeting a client tomorrow afternoon.

steps.text: Could we postpone it until Tuesday afternoon?
steps.focus: postpone 重音在第二音节 post-PONE

steps.q: Please read the ___ before the meeting so you know what we'll discuss.
Who is taking the ___ today?
All ___ must register at the front desk.
The meeting was ___ at 5 p.m. and will continue tomorrow.
Could you ___ the main points in one paragraph?
a: summarize
summarise

steps.q: Everyone is welcome to ___ in the discussion.
a: participate

steps.a: Let's reschedule the meeting for next Tuesday.
steps.zh: 我们把会改到下周二吧。

steps.a: I'll update the agenda and send it to all attendees.

a: What's your availability next week?
When are you available next week?
When are you free next week?

points: 重点：postpone / put off 推迟、move up 提前、reschedule 改时间；postpone doing。
重点：约好的安排用进行时，临时决定用 will，时刻表用一般现在时。

steps.title: 一封通知邮件
lines: To: All staff  From: Office Manager  Subject: Office closure
收件人：全体员工  发件人：办公室经理  主题：办公室关闭
I'm writing to notify you that the office will be closed on Friday for maintenance.
特此通知：周五办公室因维修关闭。
Please save your work prior to leaving on Thursday.
请在周四离开前保存好工作。
Please find attached the updated floor plan.
附件是更新后的楼层平面图。
If you have any questions, please let me know.
如有任何问题，请告诉我。
steps.note: TOEIC Part 6 和 Part 7 一大半是邮件。固定句型认熟，读题速度会快很多。

steps.title: 邮件的开头和结尾：固定句型
what: 开头说目的：I'm writing to inform you / confirm / ask about …；I'm writing regarding + 名词
附件：Please find attached …；I have attached …；纸质信用 Enclosed is / are …
结尾：Please let me know if you have any questions. / I look forward to hearing from you.
why: Part 7 的第一题几乎总是“What is the purpose of the e-mail?”—— 答案就在 I'm writing to … 那一句。先找这句，能省一半时间。
look forward to 后面接 名词或 doing，是 Part 5 常考点。
zh: 中文邮件常用“您好！关于……”直接开始；英语商务邮件第一句通常就点明目的：I'm writing to …。
ex: I'm writing to confirm your reservation for May 3.
特此确认您 5 月 3 日的预订。
Please find attached the revised contract.
附件是修改后的合同。
I look forward to hearing from you.
期待您的回复。
err: I look forward to hear from you.
I look forward to hearing from you.
Please find the attached the file.
steps.sum: 目的 → I'm writing to …；附件 → Please find attached …；结尾 → look forward to doing。

drill.q: I look forward to ___ with you.
What does “I'm writing to inform you that our office is moving” tell you?
o: 邮件的目的：通知办公室搬迁

a: I look forward to hearing from you.
I'm looking forward to hearing from you.

steps.title: 书面介词短语：prior to、as of、until further notice、on behalf of
what: prior to = before（正式）：prior to the meeting
as of + 日期 = 从……起：As of May 1, the price will rise.
until further notice = 在另行通知之前；on behalf of = 代表……
why: 这些短语在通知、公告里极常见，TOEIC 会换成普通说法考同义替换：prior to → before，as of → starting，on behalf of → representing。
prior to 的 to 是介词，后面接名词或 doing：prior to leaving。
zh: 中文“自 5 月 1 日起”很容易写成 from May 1 on；通知里更地道的是 As of May 1 / Effective May 1。
ex: Please arrive 15 minutes prior to the interview.
请在面试前 15 分钟到达。
As of Monday, the cafeteria will open at 7 a.m.
从周一起，食堂早上 7 点开门。
The parking lot is closed until further notice.
停车场关闭，恢复时间另行通知。
err: Please save your files prior to leave.
Please save your files prior to leaving.
I'm writing on behalf my manager.
I'm writing on behalf of my manager.
steps.sum: prior to（之前）+ doing；as of（自……起）；until further notice；on behalf of。

drill.q: ___ next month, all employees must wear ID badges.
Please turn off your computer prior to ___ the office.

a: The parking lot is closed until further notice.
The parking lot will be closed until further notice.

steps.text: I'm writing to notify you that the office will be closed on Friday.
steps.zh: 特此通知周五办公室关闭。
steps.focus: notify 重音在第一音节 NO-ti-fy

steps.q: Please keep this information ___. Do not share it with anyone outside the team.
I'm writing to ___ about the job you advertised.
The manager sent a ___ to all staff about the new parking rules.
I couldn't open the ___. Could you send the file again?
a: attachment

steps.q: Please ___ me if your plans change.
a: notify
inform
tell

steps.a: Please find attached the updated floor plan.
steps.zh: 附件是更新后的楼层平面图。

steps.a: I'm writing to confirm your reservation.

steps.zh: 我代表全体员工写信给您。
a: I'm writing on behalf of all the staff.
I am writing on behalf of all the staff.
I'm writing on behalf of the entire staff.

points: 重点：I'm writing to …（目的）/ Please find attached … / look forward to doing。
重点：prior to、as of、until further notice、on behalf of。

steps.title: 打电话找人
lines: A
Good morning, Westfield Design. How may I help you?
早上好，韦斯特菲尔德设计公司。有什么可以帮您？
B
Hello, this is Mark Lee from Brightline. Could I speak to Ms. Tanaka, please?
你好，我是 Brightline 公司的马克·李。请找田中女士。
A
I'm afraid she's in a meeting right now. Can I take a message?
恐怕她现在在开会。需要我帮您留言吗？
B
Yes, please ask her to call me back. It's about the new contract.
好的，请她给我回个电话，是关于新合同的事。
A
Certainly. I'll let her know as soon as she's available.
好的。她一有空我就转告她。
steps.note: Part 3 的电话对话开头几句就交代了：谁打来、找谁、为什么。

steps.title: 电话里自报姓名：This is …，不说 I am …
what: 电话里介绍自己：This is Mark (speaking). / Mark speaking.
问对方是谁：Who's calling, please? / May I ask who's calling?
找人：Could I speak to …? / Is … available?
why: 电话里看不见人，英语习惯用 this / that 指“这个声音”。I am Mark 在电话里听起来很生硬。
zh: 中文“我是马克”直译 I am Mark 在当面介绍时可以，打电话要说 This is Mark。问“你是谁？”也不说 Who are you?（很不礼貌）。
ex: Hello, this is Sarah from Accounting.
你好，我是会计部的莎拉。
May I ask who's calling?
请问您是哪位？
Is Mr. Kim available?
金先生在吗？
err: Hello, I am Mark from Brightline.
Hello, this is Mark from Brightline.
steps.sum: 电话里：This is … (speaking)；问对方：May I ask who's calling?

drill.q: （电话里）你好，我是销售部的安娜。
o: Hello, I'm Anna from Sales speaking.
Hello, this is Anna from Sales.
Hello, here is Anna from Sales.

drill.q: 问对方是谁，最礼貌的是？

a: May I ask who's calling?
Who's calling, please?
May I ask who is calling?

x: Could I speak to Mr. Brown, please?
She's out right now. Can I take a message?
她现在不在，需要留言吗？
Hold on, please. I'll put you through.
I'll put you through to the sales department.
Could you ask him to call me back?
能让他给我回个电话吗？

steps.title: 礼貌请求：Could / Would / May
what: 请对方做事：Could you …? / Would you …? / Would you mind doing …?
请求允许：May I …? / Could I …?
回答：Sure. / Certainly. / Of course.；Would you mind …? 同意要说 Not at all.
why: 商务英语里 Can you …? 有点随便，Could / Would 更客气。这和 Part 2 的“请求题”直接相关：正确回答多是接受、婉拒或附条件。
zh: 中文“麻烦你……”“能不能……”语气靠“麻烦、请”；英语靠情态动词的过去形（could、would）。Would you mind …? 字面是“你介意吗”，所以“不介意”= 同意。
ex: Could you spell your last name, please?
请拼一下您的姓好吗？
Would you mind calling back after lunch?
您介意午饭后再打来吗？
May I leave a message?
我可以留个言吗？
err: Would you mind to call back later?
Would you mind calling back later?
A: Would you mind waiting? B: Yes, of course.
steps.sum: 请求用 Could / Would you …?；Would you mind doing …? → 同意说 Not at all。

drill.q: Would you mind ___ the door?
A: Would you mind holding for a moment? B: ___

drill.zh: 能让他给我回个电话吗？
a: Could you ask him to call me back?
Could you ask him to call me back, please?
Would you ask him to call me back?

steps.text: Hello, this is Mark Lee from Brightline. Could I speak to Ms. Tanaka, please?
steps.zh: 你好，我是 Brightline 的马克·李，请找田中女士。
steps.focus: Could I 连读 /kʊdaɪ/，句尾 please 语调下降

steps.q: I'm afraid Ms. Ito is out today. ___
Please hold on. I'll put you ___ to the manager.
I'm taking a ___ tomorrow, so please contact my coworker.
Our ___ is very heavy this month, so we need more staff.
a: workload

steps.q: Ask your ___ to approve the request first.
a: supervisor
manager
boss

steps.a: Could you ask her to call me back?
steps.zh: 能让她给我回个电话吗？

steps.a: I'm afraid she's in a meeting right now.

a: This is she.
This is he.
Speaking.
This is me speaking.
steps.e: 电话里“我就是”：Speaking. / This is he（she）.

points: 重点：电话里 This is … speaking；May I ask who's calling? / Could I speak to …? / Can I take a message?
重点：Could / Would you …?；Would you mind doing …? → Not at all。

steps.title: 一周的工作
lines: A
How was your first week at headquarters?
在总部的第一周怎么样？
B
Busy! I've already submitted three reports, and I worked overtime twice.
很忙！我已经交了三份报告，还加了两次班。
A
Wow. Are they assigning you a new project?
哇。他们要给你派新项目吗？
B
Yes. I'm meeting my supervisor tomorrow to talk about it.
是的。我明天和主管见面谈这件事。
A
Don't forget to fill in your timesheet before Friday.
别忘了周五前填工时表。
steps.note: 五个时态在一段对话里全出现了。这一课把它们放在一起，用时间词来选时态。

steps.title: 时态选择：先找时间词
what: every day / usually / always → 一般现在时
now / right now / at the moment / this week（正在）→ 现在进行时
yesterday / last week / ago / in 2020 → 一般过去时
already / yet / so far / since / for → 现在完成时
tomorrow / next week / soon → will / be going to / 进行时（安排）
why: TOEIC Part 5 每套都有 3–5 道时态题，绝大多数靠句中的时间词就能秒选，不需要读懂全句。
注意 by + 将来时间 → 将来完成时（will have done）：By Friday, we will have finished the report.（第三学期会细讲）
zh: 中文动词没有时态，“我交了报告”可能是 I submitted（昨天交的）也可能是 I have submitted（已经交了，结果还在）。看有没有具体过去时间：有 → 过去时；没有、强调“已经” → 完成时。
ex: She usually takes the bus to work.
她通常坐公交上班。
The team is working on the budget right now.
团队现在正在做预算。
I submitted the report yesterday.
我昨天交了报告。
I have already submitted the report.
我已经交了报告。
err: I have submitted the report yesterday.
有过去时间 → 过去时
steps.sum: 先圈时间词：usually 现在 / now 进行 / ago 过去 / already, since 完成 / next 将来。

drill.q: Mr. Davis ___ for this company since 2018.
The new manager ___ the staff two days ago.
Please be quiet. The director ___ a presentation right now.

a: I've already submitted three reports.
I have already submitted three reports.
I've already handed in three reports.

steps.title: assign / submit 的搭配
what: assign sb to sth / assign sth to sb：分配、指派 —— They assigned her to the sales team.
submit sth to sb：提交 —— Please submit the form to HR. = hand in
被动常见：be assigned to …（被分到……）
why: Part 5 常把 submit 和 summit、admit 放在一起考形近词；assign 常和 sign、design 放在一起。认准搭配 submit … to …、assign … to …。
zh: 中文“交给人事部”的“给”英语用 to：submit it to HR，不是 submit HR it。
ex: Please submit your timesheet to the payroll office.
请把工时表交给工资部门。
Ms. Lee was assigned to the new project.
李女士被分到了新项目。
err: Please submit the form at HR.
Please submit the form to HR.
He was assigned the Tokyo office.
He was assigned to the Tokyo office.
steps.sum: submit sth to sb；assign sb to sth / be assigned to。

drill.q: All reports must be ___ to the manager by Friday.
Two new trainees were assigned ___ our department.

steps.text: I've already submitted three reports, and I worked overtime twice.
steps.zh: 我已经交了三份报告，还加了两次班。
steps.focus: I've 不要读成 I；submitted 重音在第二音节

steps.q: New employees must attend an ___ session on their first day.
Only full-time staff are ___ for the bonus.
Questions about your salary should go to the ___ department.
The company's ___ is in New York, but it has offices in five countries.
a: headquarters

steps.q: Your annual performance ___ will take place in December.
a: evaluation
review

steps.zh: 她从 2020 年起就在这里工作。
a: She has worked here since 2020.
She's worked here since 2020.
She has been working here since 2020.

points: 重点：时态先找时间词 —— usually / now / ago / already, since / next。
重点：submit sth to sb；assign sb to sth / be assigned to。

steps.title: A Busy Monday
steps.note: TOEIC Part 7 式的阅读：先看题目再读文章，带着问题找答案。先关掉译文读。
lines: To: All Marketing Staff
收件人：市场部全体员工
From: Diane Cole, Office Manager
发件人：办公室经理黛安·科尔
Subject: This week's schedule changes
主题：本周日程变更
I'm writing to let you know about some changes to this week's schedule.
特此告知本周日程的几项变更。
First, Tuesday's team meeting has been postponed until Thursday at 10 a.m. because Mr. Hill is visiting a client in Boston.
第一，周二的团队会议推迟到周四上午十点，因为希尔先生要去波士顿拜访客户。
The updated agenda is attached. Please read it prior to the meeting.
更新后的议程见附件，请在会前阅读。
Second, the copier on the third floor is out of order.
第二，三楼的复印机坏了。
A technician will repair it on Wednesday. Until then, please use the one next to the reception desk.
技术员周三来修。在那之前，请使用前台旁边的那台。
Finally, two interns will join our team as of next Monday.
